title: NeuroWare Catalyst Fund - UK Neuromorphic Computing Hardware IKC
summary: The NeuroWare Catalyst Fund supports researchers in advancing neuromorphic technologies from proof-of-concept to real-world deployment within the UK ecosystem. It offers three funding routes: Scoping & Discovery Awards (£10k–£25k, 6–12 weeks), Open Catalyst Awards (up to £100k, 6–12 months), and Strategic Demonstrator Awards (up to £100k+, 6–12 months). Projects must align with NeuroWare technical workstreams and address clear needs or opportunities. Funding covers up to 80% of Full Economic Costs for eligible applicants based at UKRI-eligible organisations, supporting staff, travel, consumables, and facilities.
tldr: NeuroWare Catalyst Fund provides flexible grants (£10k–£25k+) to accelerate neuromorphic technology validation, demonstrators, and commercialisation in the UK.
evidence: The NeuroWare Catalyst Fund helps researchers move promising neuromorphic technologies beyond the lab and towards real-world use.
We welcome proposals at different stages of development, from early feasibility studies and proof-of-concept activity through to technology validation, demonstrators and challenge-led projects.
